lede: Atlanta Falcons carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#20 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Atlanta Falcons -5.5 with a fair total of 42.2 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Carolina Panthers pass offence vs Atlanta Falcons pass defence, which sits −0.098 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
